meta.title: Open-source contribution tracker
meta.focus: Hardware verification & EDA — projects backed by Google, Intel, CHIPS Alliance, FOSSi.
meta.note: Single source of truth for the tracker. Written by the `contributie` MCP server now (refresh/set_recap/add_* tools); designed so Hermes can write the same file later. index.html renders this at runtime.
meta.hermes_seam: Any writer that preserves this schema (meta + contributions[] + potential_prs[] + potential_issues[]) can own updates. Statuses: merged | review | awaiting | closed. Keep `recap` human-written; refresh only touches status/comments/diff/dates.

contributions.title: Update docs/README.md
contributions.recap: Rewrites Chisel's docs/README.md, whose build instructions no longer worked: the build moved from SBT (`docs/mdoc`) to Mill (`./mill mdoc`), the undocumented Scala CLI and Verilator prerequisites made the build fail partway with confusing errors, the website moved from a separate repo into `website/` (Docusaurus), `ChiselStage.emitVerilog` became `emitSystemVerilog`, and the per-directory Contents links pointed one directory too deep. Adds the two sections the issue asked for: where each kind of documentation belongs, and how to render the website locally. Fixes #4402.

contributions.title: docs: Add how-to guide on separating cocotb and simulator logs
contributions.recap: Adds a how-to guide to cocotb's docs showing how to route cocotb's own log records to a file while leaving the simulator's stdout transcript untouched — by removing the root logger's handlers and registering your own. Verified on Icarus Verilog and Cadence Xcelium.

contributions.title: Return the original signal when replicating by 1
contributions.recap: Fixes ROHD so replicating a signal one time returns the original signal instead of emitting redundant SystemVerilog (`{1{a}}`); signExtend inherits the fix. Adds regression tests asserting signal identity and the absence of `{1{` in generated SV — the invariants the old value-only test missed.

contributions.title: Add MULTIDRIVENPROC warning for signals driven by multiple plain always blocks
contributions.recap: Adds a new Verilator lint warning, MULTIDRIVENPROC, that flags a signal whose whole value is driven from more than one plain `always` block — a synthesis hazard that still simulates fine. Classified as an off-by-default code-style warning, and suppressed when the two drivers are differently clocked (the on-by-default MULTIDRIVEN already covers that case). C++ across V3Undriven/V3Error, with a generated docs example and regression tests.

contributions.title: formatter: Keep space before # in unqualified typedef
contributions.recap: Fixes the SystemVerilog formatter to keep the space before `#` in an unqualified parameterized-typedef declaration (issue #850), following the merged sibling fix pattern from PR #705. Small, two-file change; green and rebased.
